article.title: Ramp推出Router，自動挑選AI模型降低企業推論成本
article.summary: 美國企業支出管理平臺Ramp周三（8/19）推出Router.com，讓企業透過單一API使用多家業者的AI模型，並依不同工作的效能、品質及成本需求，自動選擇適合的模型。Ramp表示，已使用Router的客戶平均可降低40%的AI推論成本。

article.title: Google’s AI coding agent just escaped its own IDE
article.summary: When Google launched Antigravity in November 2025, it was on the premise that developers could hand an entire coding task to an AI agent and let it run. But developers still need to work directly in their code editor. Google announced Thursday that it is expanding Antigravity into developers’ existing workflows through new extensions for Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains IDEs and Zed. The company is also making Antigravity available through eligible Gemini Enterprise subscriptions. The extensions let developers open agent conversations in a side panel, review inline diffs, inspect plans and delegate multi-step engineering tasks without moving a project into the Antigravity 2.0 desktop application. article.title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
article.summary: Nvidia research shows that AI agents can perform well, and not go off the deep end, through fine-tuning, even if the AI model isn't that great at the task.
